title: Provenance Record
description: A record attached to a generated output, documenting which artist adapter, prompt, and base model produced it.

schema_version.description: Version of this provenance record schema, e.g. '1.0.0'.

artist_name.description: Human-readable name of the artist whose adapter was used.

artist_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the artist.

adapter_version.description: Version of the artist adapter used for this generation.

adapter_hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the adapter weights, hex-encoded.

prompt.description: The prompt text used to produce the output.

timestamp.description: When the output was generated, as an ISO 8601 date-time.

base_model.description: Name and version of the base model the adapter was applied to.

base_model_licence.description: Licence under which the base model is distributed.

watermark_id.description: Identifier embedded in the audio watermark. Null until watermarking is implemented.
